content.title: Cracker Barrel is offering a $16 Easter feast that feeds 10 – it’s ready to serve and comes with two pies
content.text: CRACKER Barrel is bringing back an Easter feast that can feed up to 10 people around the table. The restaurant chain’s Heat n’ Serve Easter meals are designed to be prepared with little fuss in the kitchen, as the chain continues its attempts to rehabilitate its damaged image following its rebrand controversy. Sign up for the Money newsletter Thank you! Cracker Barrel is now taking orders for its Easter Sunday pre-prepared mealsCredit: Cracker Barrel Orders must be placed 24 hours in advance before pickup and can be placed using Cracker Barrel’s online catering serviceCredit: Cracker Barrel Easter diners can get multiple versions of the meals, as well as desserts. The meals are available to pre-order now and can be picked up between Thursday and Sunday. All of the meals are pre-prepared and just need to be heated up before tucking in. Orders must be placed 24 hours in advance before pickup and can be placed using Cracker Barrel‘s online catering service. read more on cracker barrel There are four main Heat n’ Serve meals available, according to USA Today: Easter Ham Heat n’ Serve Feast: spiral-sliced sugar-cured ham, macaroni n’ cheese, carrots, mashed potatoes with gravy, green beans, rolls, apple streusel pie and pecan pie (serves eight to 10). Cost: $169.99 Easter Ham Heat n’ Serve Family Dinner: spiral-sliced sugar-cured ham, macaroni n’ cheese, mashed potatoes with gravy, green beans, sweet yeast rolls (serves four to six). Cost: $114.99 Prime Rib Heat n’ Serve Family Dinner: prime rib, au jus and horseradish, macaroni n’ cheese, mashed potatoes with gravy, green beans, sweet yeast rolls (serves four to six). Cost: $139.99 Easter Ham and Turkey Hot & Ready Family Dinner: Comes ready to serve. Includes turkey with turkey gravy, slices of sugar-cured ham, green beans, macaroni & cheese, mashed potatoes, dinner rolls and pecan pie. (Serves four to six). Cost: $104.99 Cracker Barrel is serving three pies this Easter, including its Apple Streusel Pie for $14.99 and Pecan Pie for $7.99. Diners can also choose a Chocolate Pecan Pie for $7.99.
